findings.title: ADR-0016 Gemini subagent mechanism has no archaeology guard against the #119 infinite-loop fix
findings.claim: ADR-0016 puts Gemini in the 'Codex, Gemini, Qwen: rewrite supported, replace only as reason/error text' row and bases the subagent case (A/B/C) on the hook payload's agent_type field, but it never records the v1 history of touching Gemini subagent hook wiring.
findings.evidence: git log --all --oneline | grep -i gemini (cm-main) shows 367fdbb1 'fix(hooks): resolve infinite loop in Gemini CLI with dynamic subagent field injection (#119)'. Full message: '... fix(hooks): resolve infinite loop in Gemini CLI with dynamic subagent field injection ... fix(hooks): remove Gemini CLI subagent aliases to avoid unauthorized MCP calls'. ADR-0016 (docs/v2/adr/0016-subagent-context-protection.md lines 16-20, 41) reintroduces per-subagent, agent_type-driven handling for Gemini without citing #119 or stating the constraint that caused it.
findings.archaeology: INTRODUCED_BY: 367fdbb1 'fix(hooks): resolve infinite loop in Gemini CLI with dynamic subagent field injection (#119)' (cm-main). ORIGINAL_INTENT (commit message): fix an infinite loop that dynamic subagent field injection caused in Gemini CLI hooks, and 'remove Gemini CLI subagent aliases to avoid unauthorized MCP calls'. REGRESSION_RISK: ADR-0016's Case B/C mechanism for Gemini depends on hook-side, per-subagent (agent_type) logic (dynamic field injection by another name) to pick the deny reason / rewritten command. If LV8-LV10 implementation adds Gemini-side subagent tool aliases or per-type dynamic hook fields to make this work, it reopens the exact bug #119 fixed. SAFE_FIX_CONSTRAINT: keep all subagent-type branching on the SERVER side (reading agent_type from the payload and choosing which deny/rewrite text to send); never add Gemini-CLI-side per-subagent-type hook config, aliases, or dynamically generated hook fields.
findings.fix: Add a line to ADR-0016's Gemini row (or a new constraint paragraph) citing #119 and stating the SAFE_FIX_CONSTRAINT above, and add it as an explicit golden/live check (LV8-LV10 or a new LV) so the Gemini subagent path is tested against the infinite-loop regression before release.

findings.title: Gemini upgrade path (extensions install) vs sibling-hooks-preserved requirement (#1239) is not cross-checked
findings.claim: map-P0.md #1239 requires: 'Install/upgrade never removes user hooks' for Gemini (Given user hook in settings, When upgrade, Then still present). ADR-0011's v1-cleanup table scopes removal to hook entries whose command contains 'context-mode', which satisfies the intent for the CLEANUP step, but the v2 UPGRADE command for Gemini (`gemini extensions install ... --ref release --auto-update`, ADR-0011 line 42) installs via the extensions mechanism, a different code path than editing `~/.gemini/settings.json` directly. No test or live check verifies that an extensions-install upgrade leaves a user's own, non-context-mode `.hooks.*` entries in `~/.gemini/settings.json` untouched.
findings.evidence: tickets/map-P0.md:42 ('1239 | gemini: keep sibling hooks on upgrade ... Install/upgrade never removes user hooks') and :59 ('Install/upgrade rule: never remove user-owned hook entries (1235, 1239)'). docs/v2/adr/0011-release-and-v1-transition.md:42 (upgrade command) and :64 (cleanup rule, a different step). No LV/golden case in ADR-0012 or ADR-0016 references #1239 for the extensions-install path.
findings.archaeology: INTRODUCED_BY: ticket #1239 (rudycelekli), listed in tickets/map-P0.md as P0 with reusable Given/When/Then. ORIGINAL_INTENT (ticket acceptance criteria): upgrading context-mode must never strip hooks the user configured for other tools. REGRESSION_RISK: low by itself, but untested; if `gemini extensions install --auto-update` ever rewrites `~/.gemini/settings.json` wholesale (as some extension managers do) instead of merging, user hooks would be silently dropped, reopening #1239. SAFE_FIX_CONSTRAINT: the upgrade step must merge into existing `.hooks.*`, never overwrite the file.
findings.fix: Add an explicit live/golden check for the Gemini extensions-install upgrade path: given a pre-existing non-context-mode hook entry in `~/.gemini/settings.json`, after `gemini extensions install --ref release --auto-update`, assert the entry is still present.
